test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

We discussed the reaction of the farmers __________ the new policy at length.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence discusses the farmers' reaction **in relation to** the new policy.
 
• The correct preposition to use when referring to someone's reaction to something is **"to."**
 
• **Options 1 (for), 2 (about),** and
